## Defects found by the sweep and fixed here

- **SIG-UI-DV08 print gap** — `planPrintPages` only emitted figure pages
  for record-declared `print_figures`, which the fixture export does not
  populate on jurisdiction dossiers: drawn fig-map figures printed nowhere.
  `web/src/lib/print.ts` gained `derivedFigures` (record-declared kinds are
  never shadowed); `print.astro` derives the drawn-map declaration from
  the visuals doc. All 10 drawn-map print routes now print the map on
  page 2; `usa/vi` (typed absence) correctly prints none.
- **SIG-UI-D20 curate leak** — the internal contradictions page rendered
  `claim.evidence_ref` bare; wrapped in `<code class="sig-mut">`.
